what: Brev spend at the end of the transfer run
note: The earlier projection said $2.61 remained before this box; at 3.28 h the box has used $2.23 of it, so the arithmetic now says about $0.38 left on that basis. The two figures disagree because the pre-box projection itself carried bounded estimates for five boxes that were deleted by their finishers. Treat $0.4 as the operative number and expect e14 to be the last clip either way.
what_this_box_bought: Six clips of the donor transfer for ~$2.23: two adoptions (e28 +0.2086 AUC and MPPE 44.07 -> 9.58 cm; e19 +0.0428, 58.10 -> 41.62), one rank point on tier1-mppe (11th -> 10th), the SP-SR board lifted 0.66667 -> 0.70000, three refuted selection hypotheses, and the discovery that the orientation patch was missing its weight parameter.
value_per_dollar: One rank point and +0.0084 of entry AUC for $2.23, against the $90 arms two free measurements priced out this morning. The cheap arm was the right call.
